decisions: Treat OCC CAS Consummated/Effective dates as regulator-record evidence of charter effectiveness, but do not infer that the trust bank has opened or begun live operations.
Preserve Ripple National Trust Bank and Circle National Trust as separate entities with distinct issuer relationships and stated initial/future scopes.

Keep RLUSD issuance with Standard Custody & Trust Company; BNY is the primary reserve custodian; Ripple National Trust Bank is described as reserve manager/collateral trustee and fiduciary custodian upon opening.
Classify BNY's XRP custody platform support as institutional custody access, not evidence of BNY proprietary XRP holdings or customer custody balances.
Classify C2FO's USD 520B historical working-capital figure as platform-wide legacy Early Pay activity, not XRPL or Instant Pay volume.
Classify C2FO Instant Pay as announced and waitlist-based; actual capital-provider funding, invoice volume and RLUSD settlement volume remain unknown.
Classify Aviva's tokenized USD Liquidity Fund share class as launched on XRPL, but its tokenized AUM, on-chain holdings and investor turnover remain unknown.
Classify SG-FORGE EURCV as launched on XRPL with Ripple custody support; collateral use is only an opportunity to explore.
Classify the Mastercard/WebBank/Gemini RLUSD settlement program as exploratory until production transactions or operational disclosures are verified.
Do not admit custody, charter, tokenization or partnership announcements as directional XRP features without measured XRP-specific capital flows or out-of-sample predictive value.
Classify Coinbase National Trust as preliminary conditional approval only as of the OCC Corporate Decision #1370 dated 2026-04-02; do not treat it as an effective or operational federal charter.

Keep Coinbase's existing NYDFS-chartered Coinbase Custody Trust Company separate from the proposed national trust bank; the OCC decision describes a planned three-year migration, not a completed migration.

Classify the proposed Coinbase National Trust's staking, Prime Trading and Prime Financing access as finder access to affiliate services for custody clients; the proposed bank itself does not provide those underlying services.
required_followup: Monitor OCC CAS and Ripple National Trust Bank opening/operational disclosures.
Verify BNY XRP custody product availability and seek published client asset balances or service activation evidence.
Track C2FO Instant Pay from waitlist to production; require invoice funding and RLUSD settlement records before counting capital.
Obtain Aviva tokenized share-class AUM, XRP Ledger issued-token balances and transfer history.
Verify EURCV collateral integration and any actual collateral balances.
Verify whether Mastercard/WebBank/Gemini has progressed from integration planning to production settlement.
Monitor the OCC CAS record for a Coinbase National Trust Consummated/Effective action and verify the bank's actual opening date.
Verify whether the planned migration from Coinbase Custody Trust Company LLC to Coinbase National Trust has begun and how XRP custody balances are allocated between entities.
